body: Agent learns its session from a new HubMsg::Bound (sent by the hub on registration and on follow_pid after /clear) gated by Register.status_lines, instead of trusting env CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (stale after /clear) or inferring it from TranscriptRead/SessionRead. Bound also serves as proof the hub takes AgentMsg::StatusLine.

"Agent present" = <state>/status/<session>.agent mark renewed every 30 s by the link while bound; fresh if younger than 120 s. statusline posts only without a fresh mark AND with a loopback hook addr; one metadata() call, no added latency. Alternative (key files by claude pid via proctree walk) rejected: ToolHelp snapshot cost on the statusline path.

Status numbers are sent by the link task itself (serve() poll branch, 1 s) rather than by serve_channel: only while a connection is up and after its own Bound; last-sent mtime resets per connection so a reconnect resends once.

Review finding 4's suggested fix (re-send bound when a StatusLine for another session arrives) rejected as the only trigger: after /clear the old session's file no longer changes, so the agent sends no mismatched frame and the retry would never fire.

Lost bound: Conn.untold set when try_send finds the queue full, retried from on_tick with a 1 s deadline (BOUND_RETRY), always sending the conn's current session. Alternative rejected: spawned send with a short wait, which can deliver an older bound after a newer one.

Status change detection compares the numbers read each tick with the last sent HookEvent; mtime dropped entirely (statusfile::changed removed). Alternative rejected: mtime fast path plus content compare, needless for one <4 KiB file per second.
